title: Code Doctor shared definitions v0
description: Primitive types shared by every Code Doctor protocol. Other schemas reference these by $ref; nothing here is a top-level document.

ulid.description: Crockford base32 ULID (26 chars). Sortable by creation time.

traceId.description: W3C trace id: 32 lowercase hex, not all zeros.

spanId.description: W3C span id: 16 lowercase hex, not all zeros.

codeVersion.description: Git commit (sha1 or sha256), or 'wt-<sha256>' for an uncommitted working tree snapshot hashed by Code Doctor.

artifactVersion.description: Version of something other than code that a conclusion depends on: application config, database schema, deployment. Usually 'sha256:<hex>' of the artifact, or a migration id.

unixNano.description: Unix time in nanoseconds as a decimal string (JSON numbers lose precision above 2^53).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, used for records produced by Code Doctor itself.

repoPath.description: Repository-relative path with forward slashes. No drive letters, no '..', no ':' '#' '@' (reserved by evidence ids).

dataClass.description: Sensitivity label. Model-routing policy (schemas/config, owned by the config protocol) decides which models may receive each class. 'local_only' must never leave the machine.

evidenceLevel.description: How strongly a fact is established. observed: raw telemetry/log/db shows it. reproduced: re-triggered in an isolated run. inferred: derived from other evidence, not directly seen. speculated: model judgement only.

layer.description: Architectural layer an event or probe belongs to.

redactedValue.description: Placeholder for a sensitive value. 'cd:redacted' drops it entirely; 'cd:redacted:hmac:<hex>' keeps a per-project keyed hash so equality can still be compared without revealing the value.

attributeValue.description: OpenTelemetry attribute value: primitive or homogeneous array of primitives.

attributes.description: OTel-style flat attribute map. Keys must be lowercase dotted names. Keys that look like credentials MUST carry a redacted placeholder, never the raw value.

modelIdentity.description: Which model produced something. Recorded for traceability only; the protocol never chooses a model (that is the user's decision, see schemas/config).

endpoint_profile.description: Id of the user's endpoint profile in schemas/config. Never the API key or base URL itself.
